notes: All is marked added; the competing reading would fold it into yachad's rendering as an All ... together frame, or treat it as a supplied quantifying determiner on tribes under rule 15. יַחַד already holds together and the noun's determiner slot holds the supplied the, so no morpheme is left to license it (rules 30, 51).
When ... were gathered divides the temporal בְּ + infinitive as rule 52 directs: the complementizer-equivalent When on the preposition, the verb on the infinitive.
